questions.question: How does your hair look when you wake up?

options.text: Pretty much the same as yesterday

questions.question: How often do you wash your hair?

options.text: Every day or every other day

questions.question: How does your hair feel by day 2-3 after washing?

options.text: Starts getting oily at the roots
Still feels dry, could go longer
Gets frizzy but not necessarily oily

routines.Curly/Wavy Hair:
• Use sulfate-free shampoos and deep condition weekly.
• Apply leave-in conditioner on damp hair, scrunch gently.
• Sleep on silk/satin pillowcases to reduce frizz.
• Try the "plopping" method for defined curls.
routines.Straight/Fine Hair:
• Use lightweight, volumizing products at roots only.
• Dry shampoo between washes to maintain body.
• Avoid heavy oils - opt for hair mists instead.
• Brush from ends up to prevent breakage.
routines.Thick/Coarse Hair:
• Use rich, moisturizing masks 1-2x weekly.
• Apply oils to mid-lengths and ends when damp.
• Use wide-tooth combs to detangle gently.
• Consider protective styles to reduce daily manipulation.
routines.Straight/Normal Hair:
• Use lightweight, volumizing products.
• Dry shampoo can extend time between washes and add body.
• Avoid heavy oils that can weigh hair down.
• Brush from ends up to prevent breakage.
